\section{Continuous paragraph}
This paragraph is intentionally long so that it continues across a page
break in a single-column article as one semantic identity rather than
two unrelated blocks. Layout recovery must emit continuation evidence
when pagination splits the same paragraph, and semantic recovery must
merge those fragments onto one node whose source anchor lists every
layout region. Additional synthetic academic prose about document
compilers, evidence pipelines, reading-order graphs, and semantic
identity follows without a paragraph break so LuaLaTeX has to ship the
overflow onto the second page. Still more filler about PhysicalDocument,
LayoutDocument, SemanticDocument, and SourceAnchor fragments inflates
the vertical extent. The sentence keeps going with repeated claims that
source layout is evidence rather than a target typesetting contract,
and that SemanticNodeID is the stable bridge between representations.
Further repetition about column breaks, page breaks, and figure
interruptions guarantees the break happens inside this paragraph and
not before the next structural element.
